verdict.label: not_ready
verdict.headline: Recorded traffic could be read later, by quantum computers or a stolen key.
verdict.reason: The site uses RSA key exchange, so the server's long-term key unlocks recorded traffic, and a future quantum computer could recover that key.

fixes.title: Stop using RSA key exchange.
fixes.detail: It also fails to protect recorded traffic against theft of the server key.

fixes.title: Turn on TLS 1.3.
fixes.detail: Post-quantum key exchange only works on TLS 1.3.

fixes.title: Turn on hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519MLKEM768).
fixes.detail: This is usually a library upgrade (OpenSSL 3.5 or later) or a setting in your hosting provider or CDN.
